from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['calibrate_affine_checks', 'align_reference_features', 'yield_gated_creep']


def calibrate_affine_checks(command: np.ndarray, stress: np.ndarray, *, command_scale: float, stress_scale: float, prior: tuple[float, float] | None = None, sweep_tol: float = 8e-4, prior_tol: float = 3e-3, pair_span: float = 0.18, dense_span: float = 0.35) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Fit one instrument; return (gain, bias) for stress = gain*command + bias.

    Supply a representative command span and a physical stress scale (e.g.
    yield stress). Sweep/prior tolerances are fractions of that stress scale;
    span thresholds are fractions of the command scale. Nonfinite checks are
    omitted. Three spaced consensus inliers can replace history; an isolated
    pair without a prior is usable if well spaced, but cannot detect a spike.
    Otherwise retain a trusted same-instrument prior's gain and update its
    offset only from compatible checks. Apply chronologically to archived
    sweeps if needed. There is no unit-gain fallback or coefficient ridge.
    """
    c, s = np.asarray(command, float), np.asarray(stress, float)
    if c.ndim != 1 or s.shape != c.shape:
        raise ValueError('checks must be matching vectors')
    params = [command_scale, stress_scale, sweep_tol, prior_tol, pair_span, dense_span]
    if not np.isfinite(params).all() or min(params) <= 0 or dense_span < pair_span:
        raise ValueError('invalid scales, tolerances, or spans')
    if prior is not None and (not np.isfinite(prior).all() or prior[0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('the prior must be a finite affine calibration with positive gain')
    finite = np.isfinite(c) & np.isfinite(s)
    c, s = c[finite], s[finite]
    if not c.size:
        if prior is None:
            raise ValueError('no checks or historical calibration')
        return tuple(map(float, prior))
    anchor = float(np.median(c))
    x, y = (c - anchor) / command_scale, s / stress_scale
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    dx = x[j] - x[i]
    wide = np.abs(dx) >= pair_span
    slopes = (y[j[wide]] - y[i[wide]]) / dx[wide]
    candidates = list(zip(slopes, y[i[wide]] - slopes * x[i[wide]]))
    if prior is not None:
        pg = prior[0] * command_scale / stress_scale
        pb = (prior[0] * anchor + prior[1]) / stress_scale
        candidates.insert(0, (pg, pb))
        candidates.extend((pg, b) for b in y - pg*x)
    best = None
    for gain, bias in candidates:
        if gain <= 0:
            continue
        error = np.abs(y - (gain*x + bias))
        use = error <= sweep_tol
        count = int(use.sum())
        span = np.ptp(x[use]) if count else 0.0
        dense = count >= 3 and span >= dense_span
        pair = prior is None and len(x) == 2 and count == 2 and span >= pair_span
        if dense or pair:
            key = (count, -float(np.minimum(error, sweep_tol).sum()))
            if best is None or key > best[0]:
                best = key, use
    if best is not None:
        use = best[1]
        gain, b = np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((x[use], np.ones(use.sum()))), y[use], rcond=None)[0]
        if gain > 0:
            gain *= stress_scale / command_scale
            return float(gain), float(b*stress_scale - gain*anchor)
    if prior is None:
        raise ValueError('checks do not resolve a positive gain; supply a trusted historical calibration')
    offsets = y - pg*x
    compatible = np.abs(offsets - pb) <= prior_tol
    if not compatible.any():
        return tuple(map(float, prior))
    delta = np.median(offsets[compatible] - pb) * stress_scale
    return float(prior[0]), float(prior[1] + delta)


def align_reference_features(raw: np.ndarray, panel: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned features and a row-level mask of original missingness.

    A comparable row-matched panel shares each group's affine gauge with the
    features. Use medians of per-control means and population SDs, excluding
    controls with fewer than two observations. Impute by inverse group/stratum
    cell-size weighting, excluding missing entries from numerator and mass.
    This uses the unlabeled rows supplied by the caller, including target rows
    when transductive alignment is intended. No gain floor or ridge is used.
    """
    raw, panel = np.asarray(raw, float), np.asarray(panel, float)
    groups, strata = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if raw.ndim != 2 or not all(raw.shape) or panel.ndim != 2 or panel.shape[0] != len(raw) or groups.shape != (len(raw),) or strata.shape != groups.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, controls, and labels must have matching rows')
    _, g = np.unique(groups, return_inverse=True)
    _, k = np.unique(strata, return_inverse=True)
    aligned = np.empty_like(raw)
    for label in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == label
        p = panel[rows]
        ok = np.isfinite(p)
        keep = ok.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no supported reference column')
        p, ok = p[:, keep], ok[:, keep]
        count = ok.sum(axis=0)
        mean = np.where(ok, p, 0.0).sum(axis=0) / count
        sd = np.sqrt((np.where(ok, p, mean) - mean).__pow__(2).sum(axis=0) / count)
        offset, spread = np.median(mean), np.median(sd)
        if not np.isfinite(spread) or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('group reference spread must be positive and finite')
        aligned[rows] = (raw[rows] - offset) / spread
    _, cell, size = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, k)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1.0 / size[cell.reshape(-1)]
    ok = np.isfinite(aligned)
    mass = w @ ok
    if np.any(mass == 0):
        raise ValueError('each feature requires an aligned observation')
    fill = (w @ np.where(ok, aligned, 0.0)) / mass
    return np.where(ok, aligned, fill), ~ok.all(axis=1)


def yield_gated_creep(history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, baseline: np.ndarray, *, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float] | None = None, strain: np.ndarray | None = None, onset: np.ndarray | None = None, incomplete: np.ndarray | None = None, taus: np.ndarray | None = None, coefficients: np.ndarray | None = None, onset_blend: float = 1.0, rank_tol: float = 1e-7) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit or evaluate an isothermal, constant hold after piecewise constant loading.

    Supply calibrated history (n,m), shared durations (m,), hold and baseline
    (n,), shared hold times (q,), and finite aligned features (n,p). Memory at
    the start of history is zero. All times share units, and onset is strain
    per time unit. Return ordered taus, coefficients, absolute strain and
    initial rate. Coefficients are two compliances, drift intercept and p
    slopes, signed hold overstress coefficient, and fast-branch history
    coefficient (four features give seven hereditary/drift and two plastic).

    Fit with strain (n,q), optional onset (n,), and physical tau_bounds;
    nonfinite observations are excluded. Prefer complete rows when their
    design supports all training-active terms. Use separate 2.5-MAD Cauchy
    scales with a 1e-7 normalized MAD floor, no coefficient ridge, and a
    relative robust-Jacobian rank gate. An unexcited plastic column is zero.
    Evaluate with ordered taus and coefficients instead. In evaluation only,
    measured finite onset on incomplete rows can correct linear drift;
    onset_blend=1 trusts the measurement and 0 disables the correction.
    """
    h, u, dt, t, x, b = (np.asarray(v, float) for v in (history, hold, durations, times, features, baseline))
    n = len(h) if h.ndim == 2 else 0
    if not n or dt.shape != (h.shape[1],) or u.shape != (n,) or b.shape != (n,) or t.ndim != 1 or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n:
        raise ValueError('incompatible physical array shapes')
    S = float(yield_stress)
    if not (np.isfinite(S) and S > 0 and 0 <= onset_blend <= 1 and 0 < rank_tol < 1) or not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (h, u, dt, t, x, b)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('require finite physical inputs, positive yield and nonnegative times')
    miss = np.zeros(n, bool) if incomplete is None else np.asarray(incomplete, bool)
    obs_rate = np.full(n, np.nan) if onset is None else np.asarray(onset, float)
    if miss.shape != (n,) or obs_rate.shape != (n,):
        raise ValueError('onset and incomplete must match the specimen rows')
    fixed = taus is not None or coefficients is not None
    p = x.shape[1] + 3
    if fixed:
        tau, coef = np.asarray(taus, float), np.asarray(coefficients, float)
        if tau.shape != (2,) or coef.shape != (p+2,) or not np.isfinite(tau).all() or not np.isfinite(coef).all() or not 0 < tau[0] < tau[1]:
            raise ValueError('evaluation requires two positive ordered taus and matching coefficients')
        T = float(tau[1])
    else:
        if tau_bounds is None:
            raise ValueError('fit requires time-constant bounds')
        low, T = map(float, tau_bounds)
        if not np.isfinite([low, T]).all() or not 0 < low < T:
            raise ValueError('time-constant bounds must be positive and ordered')
        absolute = np.asarray(strain, float)
        if absolute.shape != (n, t.size):
            raise ValueError('fit requires strain shaped (n,q)')
        y = np.column_stack((absolute - b[:, None], obs_rate*T))
    units = np.r_[S, S, np.full(p-2, T), S**2*T, S**3*T]
    h, u, dt, t = h/S, u/S, dt/T, t/T
    ov = np.sign(u)*np.maximum(np.abs(u)-1, 0)**2
    work = (np.maximum(np.abs(h)-1, 0)**2 @ dt)*u
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x, ov))
    base = np.zeros((n, t.size+1, p+2))
    base[:, :-1, 2:p+1] = t[None, :, None]*drift[:, None, :]
    base[:, -1, 2:p+1] = drift

    def design(log_tau: np.ndarray, derivative: bool = False):
        q = np.exp(log_tau)
        z = np.zeros((n, 2))
        dz = np.zeros_like(z)
        for load, step in zip(h.T, dt):
            r = step/q
            decay = np.exp(-r)
            if derivative:
                dz = decay*dz + decay*r*(z-load[:, None])
            z = decay*z - np.expm1(-r)*load[:, None]
        gap = u[:, None]-z
        r = t[:, None]/q
        response = -np.expm1(-r)
        a = base.copy()
        a[:, :-1, :2] = gap[:, None, :]*response
        a[:, -1, :2] = gap/q
        a[:, :-1, -1] = work[:, None]*response[:, 0]
        a[:, -1, -1] = work/q[0]
        if not derivative:
            return a
        dresp = -r*np.exp(-r)
        d = np.empty((n, t.size+1, 3))
        d[:, :-1, :2] = gap[:, None, :]*dresp - dz[:, None, :]*response
        d[:, -1, :2] = -(dz+gap)/q
        d[:, :-1, 2] = work[:, None]*dresp[:, 0]
        d[:, -1, 2] = -work/q[0]
        return a, d

    if fixed:
        pred = design(np.log(tau/T)) @ (coef*units)
        use = miss & np.isfinite(obs_rate)
        delta = onset_blend*(obs_rate[use]*T-pred[use, -1])
        pred[use, :-1] += delta[:, None]*t
        pred[use, -1] += delta
        return tau, coef, b[:, None]+pred[:, :-1], pred[:, -1]/T

    active = np.r_[np.ones(p, bool), np.any(ov != 0), np.any(work != 0)]
    observed = np.isfinite(y)
    if not observed[:, :-1].any():
        raise ValueError('fit requires observed hold strains')
    grid = np.linspace(np.log(low/T), 0.0, 7)
    trial_taus = [grid[[i, j]] for i, j in zip(*np.triu_indices(grid.size, 1))]
    complete = observed & ~miss[:, None]
    if miss.any() and complete[:, :-1].any():
        for trial in trial_taus:
            m = design(trial)[complete][:, active]
            norm = np.linalg.norm(m, axis=0)
            if np.all(norm > 0) and np.linalg.matrix_rank(m/norm, tol=rank_tol) == active.sum():
                observed = complete
                break
    level = np.abs(y[observed])
    E = float(np.median(level)) or float(level.max())
    if E == 0:
        raise ValueError('observations contain no strain or onset signal')
    target = y[observed]/E
    rate_row = np.broadcast_to(np.arange(t.size+1) == t.size, y.shape)[observed]

    def scales(resid: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        def mad(values: np.ndarray) -> float:
            if not values.size:
                return 1.0
            return float(max(1e-7, 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(values-np.median(values)))))
        return 2.5*np.where(rate_row, mad(resid[rate_row]), mad(resid[~rate_row]))

    seeds = []
    for trial in trial_taus:
        a = design(trial)[observed][:, active]
        c = np.linalg.lstsq(a, target, rcond=None)[0]
        for _ in range(2):
            resid = a@c-target
            w = 1/np.hypot(scales(resid), resid)
            c = np.linalg.lstsq(a*w[:, None], target*w, rcond=None)[0]
        seeds.append((trial, c, a@c-target))
    pilot = min(seeds, key=lambda seed: np.median(np.abs(seed[2][~rate_row])))
    scale = scales(pilot[2])
    seeds.sort(key=lambda seed: np.log1p((seed[2]/scale)**2).sum())
    sep = 1e-5
    lo = grid[0]
    if not lo < -sep:
        raise ValueError('bounds do not span two separated time constants')
    nc = int(active.sum())
    lower = np.r_[lo, 0.0, np.full(nc, -np.inf)]
    upper = np.r_[-sep, 1.0, np.full(nc, np.inf)]

    def unpack(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([v[0], v[0]+sep+(-v[0]-sep)*v[1]])

    def residual(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return (design(unpack(v))[observed][:, active]@v[2:]-target)/scale

    def jacobian(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a, d = design(unpack(v), True)
        d = d[observed]
        fast = d[:, 0]*v[2]
        if active[-1]:
            fast += d[:, 2]*v[-1]
        slow = d[:, 1]*v[3]
        return np.column_stack((fast+(1-v[1])*slow, (-v[0]-sep)*slow, a[observed][:, active]))/scale[:, None]

    fits = []
    for trial, c, _ in seeds[:4]:
        first = min(trial[0], -2*sep) if lo <= -2*sep else lo
        fraction = np.clip((trial[1]-first-sep)/(-first-sep), 0, 1)
        fit = least_squares(residual, np.r_[first, fraction, c], jac=jacobian, bounds=(lower, upper), loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=150)
        if fit.success:
            fits.append(fit)
    if not fits:
        raise ValueError('no robust creep fit converged')
    fit = min(fits, key=lambda result: result.cost)
    norm = np.linalg.norm(fit.jac, axis=0)
    if fit.jac.shape[0] < norm.size or np.any(norm == 0):
        raise ValueError('insufficient excitation to identify creep parameters')
    sv = np.linalg.svd(fit.jac/norm, compute_uv=False)
    if sv[-1] <= rank_tol*sv[0]:
        raise ValueError('creep parameters are locally rank deficient')
    log_tau = unpack(fit.x)
    beta = np.zeros(p+2)
    beta[active] = fit.x[2:]*E
    pred = design(log_tau)@beta
    return np.exp(log_tau)*T, beta/units, b[:, None]+pred[:, :-1], pred[:, -1]/T

def run_self_test():
    c = np.linspace(-2., 2., 7)

    a, shift, S = 2.5, -3., 0.01
    g2, b2 = calibrate_affine_checks(a*c+shift, S*bad, command_scale=4*a, stress_scale=2*S)
    np.testing.assert_allclose([g2*a/S, (b2+g2*shift)/S], gain_bias, atol=1e-13)
    sparse = calibrate_affine_checks(c[:1], s[:1]+0.002, command_scale=4., stress_scale=2., prior=gain_bias)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sparse, [1.3, -0.198], atol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrate_affine_checks(c[:1], s[:1]+3., command_scale=4., stress_scale=2., prior=gain_bias), gain_bias)
    with np.testing.assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_affine_checks(c[:1], s[:1], command_scale=4., stress_scale=2.)

    g = np.array([5, 5, 5, 9, 9])
    stratum = np.array([0, 1, 1, 0, 0])
    gain, offset = np.where(g == 5, 2., 5.), np.where(g == 5, 12., -4.)
    z = np.sqrt(1.5)
    panel = (offset + gain*np.array([-z, 0., z, -1., 1.]))[:, None]
    raw = (offset + gain*np.array([0., 2., 4., 6., np.nan]))[:, None]
    x0, missing = align_reference_features(raw, panel, g, stratum)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x0[:, 0], [0., 2., 4., 6., 2.4], atol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(missing, [False, False, False, False, True])
    perm = np.array([4, 1, 3, 0, 2])
    x2, m2 = align_reference_features(3*raw[perm]-9, 3*panel[perm]-9, -g[perm], stratum[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x2, x0[perm], atol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(m2, missing[perm])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(17)
    n = 44
    sy, tau = 2., np.array([0.5, 2.])
    dt, t = np.array([0.25, 0.4, 0.7]), np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.08, 6., 14)]
    h = rng.uniform(-3.6, 3.6, (n, len(dt)))
    u = rng.uniform(-3.6, 3.6, n)
    h[:4] = [[2., -2., 2.], [2.8, 0., 0.], [0., 0., 0.], [2.8, 0., 0.]]
    u[:4] = [2., 1., -2.8, 0.]
    x, base = rng.normal(size=(n, 4)), rng.normal(scale=0.01, size=n)
    coef = np.array([0.18, 0.34, 0.04, -0.02, 0.035, 0.01, -0.015, 0.12, 0.08])

    state = h @ (np.exp(-tail[:, None]/tau)-np.exp(-(tail+dt)[:, None]/tau))
    branch = (u[:, None]-state)*coef[:2]
    # Independent physical construction, using the specified signed and unsigned doses.
    o = np.where(np.abs(u)>sy, np.sign(u)*(np.abs(u)-sy)**2, 0.)
    w = u*np.sum(np.where(np.abs(h)>sy, (np.abs(h)-sy)**2, 0.)*dt, axis=1)
    ordinary = coef[2] + x@coef[3:7]
    drift = ordinary + coef[-2]*o
    branch[:, 0] += coef[-1]*w
    want = base[:, None] + branch @ (1-np.exp(-t[None, :]/tau[:, None])) + drift[:, None]*t
    rate = branch @ (1/tau) + drift
    _, _, y, r = yield_gated_creep(h, u, dt, t, x, base, yield_stress=sy, taus=tau, coefficients=coef)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(y, want, atol=2e-14)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(r, rate, atol=2e-14)
    _, _, elastic, _ = yield_gated_creep(h, u, dt, t, x, base, yield_stress=sy, taus=tau, coefficients=np.r_[coef[:-2], 0., 0.])
    np.testing.assert_allclose((y-elastic)[[0, 3]], 0., atol=2e-14)
    np.testing.assert_allclose((y-elastic)[1], coef[-1]*w[1]*(1-np.exp(-t/tau[0])), atol=2e-14)
    np.testing.assert_allclose((y-elastic)[2], coef[-2]*o[2]*t, atol=2e-14)
    assert w[1] > 0 and o[2] < 0

    dirty = want.copy()

    dirty[7, 8] -= 2.

    incomplete = np.arange(n) == 1
    fit_tau, fit_coef, fit_y, fit_r = yield_gated_creep(h, u, dt, t, x, base, yield_stress=sy, tau_bounds=(0.125, 8.), strain=dirty, onset=rate, incomplete=incomplete)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit_tau, tau, rtol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit_coef, coef, rtol=2e-4, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit_y, want, atol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fit_r, rate, atol=2e-5)

    # Stress unit conversion, doubled inverse time, and specimen reordering.
    T = 0.5
    rows = rng.permutation(n)
    scale = np.r_[S, S, np.full(5, T), S**2*T, S**3*T]
    t2, c2, y2, r2 = yield_gated_creep(S*h[rows], S*u[rows], T*dt, T*t, x[rows], base[rows], yield_stress=S*sy, tau_bounds=(T*0.125, T*8.), strain=dirty[rows], onset=rate[rows]/T, incomplete=incomplete[rows])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(t2/T, fit_tau, rtol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(c2*scale, fit_coef, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(y2, fit_y[rows], atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(r2*T, fit_r[rows], atol=2e-6)
    assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (t2, c2, y2, r2))

    _, _, adjusted, adjusted_rate = yield_gated_creep(h, u, dt, t, x, base, yield_stress=sy, taus=tau, coefficients=coef, onset=rate+0.2, incomplete=incomplete, onset_blend=0.75)
    delta = 0.15*incomplete
    np.testing.assert_allclose(adjusted, want + delta[:, None]*t, atol=2e-14)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(adjusted_rate, rate + delta, atol=2e-14)


run_self_test()
"
}
